}} The '''Squire's Helmet''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained as a monster drop from [[Metal Head]]s, [[Hot Head]]s and [[Metal Head (dangerous)]]. The Squire's Helmet will drop when the number of Metal Heads / Hot Heads / Metal Heads (dangerous) killed + a unique ID assigned to the save file can divide evenly by 100, with no remainder. In the worst case scenario, 99 Metal Heads must be slain to obtain the first Helmet. ==References== See MetalHead::getExtraDropItems in the game code. ==History== {{History|1.4|Introduced.}} {{History|1.5|Now drops from [[Hot Head]] and [[Metal Head (dangerous)]].}} {{NavboxClothing}} [[Category:Hats]] [[de:Knappenhelm]] [[es:Casco de escudero]] [[fr:Heaume d'écuyer]] [[it:Elmo da scudiero]] [[ja:エスクワイアのカブト]] [[ko:종자의 투구]] [[hu:Apród sisak]] [[pt:Elmo de Escudeiro]] [[ru:Шлем сквайра]] [[tr:Yaver Miğferi]] [[zh:护卫头盔]]
